div.head: V As Prol., 3
div.ab: And se ðe hi feormige oþþe heora manna ænigne, oþþe ænig mon him tosende, sy he scildig his sylfes ⁊ ealles ðæs ðe he age; þæt is ðonne forðæm ðe ða aþas ⁊ ða borgas syn ⁊ ða wed ealle oferhefene ⁊ abrocene, ðe ðæs geseald wæron. And we nyten nanum oþrum ðingum to getreowiganne, butan hit ðis sy.

⁊ se þe hy feormige oþþe hyra manna ænigne, oððe ænigne man tosænde, sy he scyldig his sylfes ⁊ ealles þæs (þe) he age: ðæt is ðonne forþon ðe ða aþas ⁊ þa wedd ⁊ þa borgas synt ealle oferhafene ⁊ abrocene, ðe þær gesealde wæron. ⁊ we nytan nanum oþrum þingum to getruwianne, butan hit ðis sy.

Qui eos firmabit uel suorum aliquem uel ad eos quemquam mittet, sui ipsius reus sit et omnium que habebit: et hoc igitur est, quia iuramenta et uadia et plegia penitus superexcepta sunt et infracta, que antea fuerant data; et nescimus alii rei credere, nisi hoc sit.

⁊ se þe hy feormige oþþe hyra manna ænigne, oððe ænigne man [him] tosænde, sy he scyldig his sylfes ⁊ ealles þæs þe he age; ðæt is ðonne forþon ðe ða aþus ⁊ þa wedd ⁊ þa borgas synt ealle oferhafene ⁊ abrocene, ðe þær gesealde wæron. ⁊ we nytan nanum oðrum þingum to getruwianne, buton hit ðis sy.

And he who harbours them, or any of their men, or sends any man to them, shall forfeit his life and all that he possesses. The cause [which has led us to issue this decree] is, that all the oaths, pledges, and sureties which were given there, have been disregarded and violated, and we know of no other course which we can follow with confidence, unless it be this.

And he who harbours them, or any of their men, or sends anyone to them, is to forfeit his life and all that he owns. That is then because the oaths and the pledges and the sureties which were given there are all disregarded and broken, and we know no other things to trust to, except it be this.

Und wer sie oder einen ihrer Leute beherbergt oder jemanden (ihnen lq) zuschickt, habe sein Leben und alles was er hat verwirkt: nämlich deshalb, weil die Eide und rechtsförmlichen Versprechungen und Verbürgungen alle vernachlässigt und gebrochen sind, welche dort gegeben waren. Und keinen anderen Einrichtungen mehr können wir vertrauen, es sei denn dies [Verpflanzen].

And whoever harbours them or any of their men, or sends anyone (to them, lq), let him have forfeited his life and all that he has: namely because the oaths and formal pledges and sureties which were given there have all been neglected and broken. And we can trust no other arrangements any more, unless it be this [transplanting].
div.note: Liebermann would supply ‘him’ in H from Ld and Quadr. (‘lq’ = Ld and Quadr. agree).
